title: Saving for a goal

screens.title: Lesson 6: Saving for a goal
screens.text: A goal is something we want that costs more than we have today. Let us plan how long it takes to reach one. Press Start when you are ready.
Our goal is a treasure. A treasure takes 100 tokens, which is about 20 dollars.
We earn about 10 tokens a day. After day 1 we have 10. After day 2 we have 20. After day 3 we have 30. We add 10 each day.

art.alt: Tokens after one, two and three days

screens.text: We keep going: day 4 is 40, day 5 is 50, day 6 is 60, day 7 is 70, day 8 is 80, day 9 is 90, day 10 is 100. After day 10 we have 100 tokens. That is enough! So the treasure takes about 10 days, which is about 2 weeks of earning 50 tokens a week.

art.alt: Day 9 has 90 tokens and day 10 has 100 tokens

screens.prompt: We earn 10 tokens a day. About how many days to reach 100 tokens?

options.label: 5 days
options.why: That is too few. After 5 days we would have only 50 tokens.

options.label: 10 days
options.why: Yes. After 10 days we have 100 tokens. After 9 days we only have 90.

options.label: 30 days
options.why: That is more days than we need. At 10 a day we get there in 10.

screens.text: Now say we get a special treat for 10 tokens on day 2. Those tokens are gone, so we have to earn them back. We need 100 plus 10, which is 110 tokens in all. At 10 a day, that takes 11 days, not 10. The treasure moves one day later.

art.alt: A special treat moves the goal from 100 tokens to 110 tokens

screens.prompt: We get a special treat for 10 tokens on day 2. We earn 10 a day. How many days to reach 100 tokens now?

options.label: 10 days, the same as before
options.why: The treat took 10 tokens away. We have to earn those back, so it takes a day longer.

options.label: 8 days
options.why: Spending does not make the goal closer. It makes it later.

options.label: 11 days
options.why: Yes. We need 110 tokens in all, and 11 days gets us to 110.

screens.text: At a store, a card swipe does the same thing. If someone saving for something swipes 4 dollars for a snack, that is real money leaving, and the goal moves later.

art.alt: Swipe 4 dollars: the account goes from 20 dollars to 16 dollars

screens.prompt: We would like a special treat today, and we are also saving for the treasure. What helps us decide?

options.label: Think about which one matters more to us right now.
options.why: Yes. Both are fine choices. A treat now moves the treasure about a day later, and we get to decide.

options.label: Always spend tokens as soon as we get them.
options.why: Then the treasure never gets closer. Thinking first helps us choose.

options.label: Never have a treat.
options.why: A treat is a fine choice sometimes. It just moves the treasure a little later.

talk.q: What is one real goal we could put on the fridge? About how many days would it take?
talk.note: Cost in tokens divided by 10 tokens a day, rounded up. The treasure (100 tokens) is about 10 days, or about 2 weeks.

talk.q: If we get a special treat on the way, how far does the goal move?
talk.note: A special treat is 10 tokens, about one day of earning, so the goal moves about one day.

talk.q: If a child pressed Ask a grown-up in this lesson, what was the question?
talk.note: Common ones: "Can I still have treats?" (yes, it moves the goal a little) and a goal your family has not set (say how it works for you).
